model_name: Bicicletă electrică de oraș Crussis e-Country AX 10.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Country AX 10.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Country AX 10.12-M2 is a city electric bike with an aluminum frame and low step-in, focused on comfortable everyday riding, commuting and longer trips. It combines easy handling, practical equipment and a powerful AVINOX drive.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. The equipment includes a 4A charger.

Comfort while riding is supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 100 mm travel. SCHWALBE Hybrid Johnny Watts 27.5 × 2.35" tires ensure stability and confidence on asphalt, paved roads and various surfaces.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12 gearing offers precise gear changes and sufficient range for urban routes and more rugged terrain. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes ensure safe deceleration.

For everyday use, there is an AVINOX 1200 lm front light and a wide range of practical accessories, thanks to which the e-bike is ready for regular commuting and longer trips.

ONE-Country AX The 10.12-M2 is suitable for riders looking for a comfortable city e-bike with a low step-in, powerful AVINOX drive and practical equipment for everyday use.

description_html:
ONE-Country AX 10.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Country AX 10.12-M2S is a city electric bike with an aluminum frame and low step-in, focused on comfortable everyday riding, commuting and longer trips. It combines easy handling, practical equipment and a powerful AVINOX drive.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2S motor, which offers power up to 1500 W, torque 130 Nm and up to 150 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery with a range of up to 157 km. The equipment includes a 12A charger.

Comfort while riding is supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 100 mm travel. SCHWALBE Hybrid Johnny Watts 27.5 × 2.35" tires ensure stability and confidence on asphalt, paved roads and various surfaces.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12 gearing offers precise gear changes and sufficient range for urban routes and more rugged terrain. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes ensure safe deceleration.

For everyday use, there is an AVINOX 1200 lm front light and a wide range of practical accessories, thanks to which the e-bike is ready for regular commuting and longer trips.

ONE-Country AX The 10.12-M2S is suitable for riders looking for a comfortable city e-bike with a low step-in, powerful AVINOX drive and practical equipment for everyday use.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică de oraș Crussis e-Country AX 8.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Country AX 8.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Country AX 8.12-M2 is a comfortable city electric bike with an aluminum frame and low step-in, which makes getting on and off easier and makes everyday use more enjoyable. It is suitable for regular commuting, city riding and longer trips, where you will appreciate the comfortable seat, easy handling and practical equipment.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort during riding is supported by the SR-SUNTOUR XCM32 LO DS suspension fork with 100 mm travel, which helps absorb bumps on city roads and cycle paths. SCHWALBE Hybrid Johnny Watts 27.5 × 2.35" tires contribute to a comfortable and confident ride on asphalt and paved roads.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a sufficient range of gears for everyday riding and longer routes. SHIMANO BR-MT200 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs ensure safe deceleration.

For everyday use, there are mudguards, a rack with MIK system, a kickstand and a chain guard. The equipment is complemented by a LITEMOVE SE-70 front light and a SUPERNOVA TL3 Z rear light.

ONE-Country AX 8.12-M2 is suitable for riders looking for a comfortable city e-bike with a low step-in, a powerful AVINOX drive and practical equipment for everyday trips and leisure trips.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB hardtail Crussis e-Country AX MTB 10.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-Country AX MTB 10.12

CRUSSIS e-Country AX MTB 10.12-M2 represents a new category of e-bikes that combines MTB character with the comfort of a city e-bike. The aluminum frame with a low step-in makes everyday use easier, while the mountain-oriented set-up gives the e-bike confidence on unpaved roads and off-road.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort and confidence while riding are supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 100 mm travel. MAXXIS Rekon 27.5 × 2.60" tires provide good traction and stability on unpaved roads and in rugged terrain.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12 gearing offers precise gear changes and a wide range for climbing and more agile riding. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes provide safe deceleration.

The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC NR telescopic seatpost, which makes it easier to change position when riding in rugged terrain.

e-Country AX MTB 10.12-M2 is suitable for riders who want to combine the comfort of a city e-bike with greater confidence and off-road capabilities. The new Country MTB concept expands everyday riding options from city streets to forest and unpaved paths.

CRUSSIS e-Country AX MTB 10.12-M2 represents a new category of e-bikes that combines MTB character with the comfort of an urban model. The aluminum frame with a low step-in makes everyday use easier, while the mountain-oriented set-up gives the e-bike confidence on unpaved roads and off-road.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery with a range of up to 157 km. A 12A charger is included.

Comfort and confidence while riding are supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 100 mm travel. MAXXIS Rekon 27.5 × 2.60" tires provide good traction and stability on unpaved roads and in rugged terrain.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12 gearing offers precise gear changes and a wide range for climbing and more agile riding. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes provide safe deceleration.

The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC NR telescopic seatpost, which makes it easier to change position when riding in rugged terrain.

e-Country AX MTB 10.12-M2 is suitable for riders who want to combine the comfort of a city e-bike with greater confidence and off-road capabilities. The new Country MTB concept expands everyday riding options from city streets to forest and unpaved paths.

CRUSSIS e-Country AX MTB 10.12-M2S represents a new category of e-bikes that combines MTB character with the comfort of an urban model. The aluminum frame with a low step-in makes everyday use easier, while the mountain-oriented set-up gives the bike confidence on unpaved roads and off-road.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2S engine, which offers power up to 1500 W, torque 130 Nm and up to 150 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery with a range of up to 157 km. A 12A charger is included.

Comfort and confidence while riding are supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 100 mm travel. MAXXIS Rekon 27.5 × 2.60" tires provide good traction and stability on unpaved roads and in rugged terrain.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12 gearing offers precise gear changes and a wide range for climbing and more agile riding. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes provide safe deceleration.

The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC NR telescopic seatpost, which makes it easier to change position when riding in rugged terrain.

e-Country AX MTB 10.12-M2S is suitable for riders who want to combine the comfort of a city e-bike with greater confidence and off-road capabilities. The new Country MTB concept expands everyday riding options from city streets to forest and unpaved paths.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB hardtail Crussis e-Country AX MTB 8.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Country AX MTB 8.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Country AX MTB 8.12-M2 is a universal e-bike that combines the comfort of a city model with the elements of a mountain e-bike. The aluminum frame with a low step-in makes it easier to get on and off and makes everyday use more enjoyable. Thanks to the wider tires and suspension fork, you don't have to limit yourself to asphalt and bike paths.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort on uneven roads is supported by the SR-SUNTOUR XCM32 LO DS suspension fork with 100 mm travel. SCHWALBE Smart Sam K-Guard 27.5 ×

2.60" tires provide stability and good traction on gravel, forest paths and other unpaved surfaces.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a sufficient range of gears for everyday riding and trips in more rugged environments. SHIMANO BR-MT200 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs ensure safe deceleration.

ONE-Country AX MTB 8.12-M2 is suitable for riders who are looking for a comfortable e-bike with a low step-up and want more freedom when choosing a route.

description_html:
ONE-Country AX MTB 8.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Country AX MTB 8.12-M2 is a universal e-bike that combines the comfort of a city model with the elements of a mountain e-bike. The aluminum frame with a low step-in makes it easier to get on and off and makes everyday use more enjoyable. Thanks to the wider tires and suspension fork, you don't have to limit yourself to asphalt and bike paths.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery with a range of up to 157 km. A 12A charger is included.

Comfort on uneven roads is supported by the SR-SUNTOUR XCM32 LO DS suspension fork with 100 mm travel. SCHWALBE Smart Sam K-Guard 27.5 × 2.60" tires provide stability and good traction on gravel, forest paths and other unpaved surfaces.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a sufficient range of gears for everyday riding and trips in more rugged environments. SHIMANO BR-MT200 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs ensure safe deceleration.

ONE-Country AX MTB 8.12-M2 is suitable for riders who are looking for a comfortable e-bike with a low step-up and want more freedom when choosing a route.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică de oraș Crussis e-Country BELT AX 10.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-Country BELT AX 10.12

CRUSSIS e-Country BELT AX 10.12 is a city electric bike with an aluminum frame and low step-in that focuses on comfort, ease of use and practicality. Thanks to the quiet belt drive and smooth manual shifting, it is suitable for everyday commuting, city driving and longer trips.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

The Gates Carbon Drive CDX belt provides quiet operation and low maintenance. The Enviolo Utility hub in conjunction with the Enviolo Grip Shift Twist Display Pure rotary controller offers smooth manual shifting, so the gear can be continuously adjusted to the pace and profile of the route without classic stepped gears.

The ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 100 mm travel supports riding comfort. SCHWALBE Motion Big Apple RaceGuard 27.5 × 2.35" tires ensure a stable and comfortable ride on asphalt and paved roads. SHIMANO Deore BR-MT410 hydraulic two-piston brakes ensure safe deceleration.

For everyday use, there is an AVINOX 1200 lm front light and a wide range of practical accessories, making the bike ready for regular commuting and longer trips.

e-Country BELT AX 10.12 is suitable for riders looking for a comfortable city e-bike with a low step-up, quiet belt drive and smooth manual shifting.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică trekking full suspension Crussis e-Country full AX 10.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Country full AX 10.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Country full AX 10.12-M2 (600 Wh) is a full-suspension electric bike with an aluminum frame and a lowered entry, designed for everyday riding, longer trips and trips on unpaved routes. It offers a comfortable seat, easy handling and practical equipment for the city and leisure.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses an M2 motor with an output of up to 1,100 W, a torque of 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in BOOST mode. The smooth drive provides the necessary support when climbing, starting off and riding with a load. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery, which allows a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort on pavement, uneven roads and lighter unpaved sections is ensured by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel and the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock. The full-suspension design helps absorb bumps and contributes to a stable and quiet ride.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing offers reliable gear selection even under higher loads. Safe deceleration is ensured by SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes with 180mm discs. SCHWALBE Johnny Watts 27.5 × 2.35" tires combine smooth movement on paved surfaces with sufficient grip off-road.

The equipment is complemented by a telescopic X-FUSION MANIC LC NR seatpost, adjustable stem, ergonomic grips and a DDK saddle with integrated handlebar. The 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touch display works with one wireless controller and also offers connection via USB-C.

For everyday use, the bike is equipped with an 1,200 lm AVINOX front light, a SUPERNOVA TL3 Z PRO rear light, mudguards, a MIK system rack, a kickstand and a cover chain. ONE-Country full AX 10.12-M2 (600 Wh) is a comfortable and practical electric bike for city traffic, trips and longer journeys.

e-Country full AX 10.12

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses an M2 motor with an output of up to 1,100 W, a torque of 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in BOOST mode. CRUSSIS e-Country full AX MTB 10.12-M2 (800 Wh) is a full-suspension e-bike with an aluminum frame and a lowered entry that combines easy handling, a comfortable seat and the ability to ride on forest roads and in lighter terrain. The 27.5" wheels support agility, while the full-suspension design contributes to greater comfort on uneven trails.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses the M2 motor with up to 1,100 W power, 110 Nm of torque and up to 125 Nm in BOOST mode. Smooth response and sensitive power dosing help on climbs and when passing through rugged sections. Energy is supplied by the removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery, which allows a range of up to 157 km. A 12A fast charger is included.

Comfort and stability are supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon air fork Silver RL with 120 mm travel together with the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock. This combination helps absorb bumps and maintain a calm ride on unpaved roads.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing ensures reliable gear selection even under heavy loads. Controlled deceleration is provided by SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes.

The MAXXIS Rekon 27.5 × 2.60" tires offer good traction, stability and comfort on the terrain. The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC NR, a SELLE ROYAL saddle and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers.

e-Country full AX MTB 10.12-M2 (800 Wh) is suitable for riders looking for a comfortable ride, agile handling and a versatile full-suspension e-bike for trips and off-road riding.

description_html:
e-Country full AX MTB 10.12

CRUSSIS e-Country full AX MTB 10.12-M2S (800 Wh) is a full-suspension e-bike with an aluminum frame and a lowered entry, which combines easy handling with equipment ready for forest roads, trips and more sporty off-road riding. The 27.5" wheels contribute to agility and confident handling, while the full-suspension design increases comfort on uneven trails.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses an M2S motor with up to 1,500 W power, 130 Nm of torque and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. Quick response and smooth power delivery provide the necessary support on climbs and on rugged sections. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery, which allows a range of up to 157 km. A 12A fast charger is included.

Comfort and contact of the wheels with the terrain are supported by ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel together with ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock. The suspension helps absorb bumps and contributes to a calm and stable ride.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing ensures reliable gear selection even when riding under load. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes are responsible for safe and well-dosed deceleration.

The MAXXIS Rekon 27.5 × 2.60" tires offer significant traction, stability and plenty of comfort on unpaved roads. The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC NR, a SELLE ROYAL saddle and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers.

e-Country full AX MTB 10.12-M2S (800 Wh) is a suitable choice for riders looking for a more comfortable ride, agile handling and the capabilities of a full-suspension mountain e-bike.

description_html:
e-Country full AX MTB 10.12

CRUSSIS e-Country full AX MTB 10.12-M2S (800 Wh) is a full-suspension e-bike with an aluminum frame and a lowered entry, which combines easy handling with equipment ready for forest roads, trips and more sporty off-road riding. The 27.5" wheels contribute to agility and confident handling, while the full-suspension design increases comfort on uneven trails.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses an M2S motor with up to 1,500 W power, 130 Nm of torque and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. Quick response and smooth power delivery provide the necessary support on climbs and on rugged sections. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery, which allows a range of up to 157 km. A 12A fast charger is included.

Comfort and contact of the wheels with the terrain are supported by ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel together with ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock. The suspension helps absorb bumps and contributes to a calm and stable ride.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing ensures reliable gear selection even when riding under load. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes are responsible for safe and well-dosed deceleration.

The MAXXIS Rekon 27.5 × 2.60" tires offer significant traction, stability and plenty of comfort on unpaved roads. The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC NR, a SELLE ROYAL saddle and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB hardtail Crussis e-Fionna AX 10.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Fionna AX 10.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Fionna AX 10.12-M2 is a mountain e-bike with an aluminum rigid frame that combines high performance with confident and natural handling. It is suitable for brisk rides, longer routes and more demanding terrain, where you will appreciate stability, comfort and plenty of power reserve.

The heart of the e-bike is the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. The AVINOX 600 Wh removable battery offers a range of up to 117 km and includes a 4A charger.

The ROCKSHOX Psylo Silver RC air fork with 130 mm travel helps smooth out bumps and contributes to more precise control of the e-bike in terrain. MAXXIS Rekon 29 × 2.60" tires provide the necessary traction and support on forest roads, gravel and more technically rugged surfaces.

Smooth and precise gear changes are provided by the SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12, which offers sufficient range for steep climbs and faster sections. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes provide confidence when braking and good control even during more dynamic riding.

Practicality in the field is increased by the X-FUSION MANIC LC NR telescopic seatpost, which allows you to quickly adjust the riding position and gain more space when descending or passing through more technical sections.

ONE-Fionna AX 10.12-M2 will appeal to riders who want a powerful mountain e-bike with a solid frame, confident off-road handling, and equipment they can rely on for shorter sporty rides and all-day trips.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 11.11 Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-Full 11.11 – Full suspension e-bike for ultimate off-road experience

Raw power, smooth suspension, and precise control – that’s the Crussis e-Full 11.11, a trail-enduro e-bike built for riders who want to conquer the most demanding trails.

The bike is powered by a top-tier Avinox M2S motor (2026) with up to 150 Nm torque in BOOST mode, delivering instant response and immense climbing power.

The integrated Avinox 600 Wh battery provides ample range for exploring challenging terrain without range anxiety.

All systems are controlled via a modern 2" OLED touch display Avinox DP100 with a wireless handlebar controller, allowing intuitive selection of assistance and maximum ride comfort.

Full-suspension frame geometry is tuned for aggressive enduro riding. The FOX AWL HD 36 Air fork (160 mm) combined with the FOX Float Rhythm Evol LV shock absorbs impacts on descents and technical sections with ease.

Precision shifting is ensured by the SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle (1x12) drivetrain with a wide 11–52T cassette and 34T crank. Smooth power transfer for climbs and sprints alike.

Hydraulic 4-piston SRAM DB8 Stealth brakes with 200 mm rotors provide dependable stopping power in any terrain or weather.

Trail-ready tires: MAXXIS ASSEGAI front and MINION DHR II rear – offering maximum grip and cornering stability.

Finishing touches include Crussis 780 mm handlebars, a X-Fusion Manic dropper post (stroke varies by frame size), and an ergonomic SELLE ROYAL saddle for all-day riding comfort.

The e-Full 11.11 combines race-ready performance with durability, function, and reliability – ready for daily rides and hardcore enduro weekends alike.

Its elegant integration into the frame maintains the bike’s sporty character and low center of gravity, positively impacting riding stability.<br /> <br />Fast recharging is ensured by a compact 12 A charger utilizing GaN fast charging technology. It charges the battery from 0% to 75% in approx. 1.5 hours and to 100% in 2 hours and 25 minutes.<br /> <br />Perfect ride control is delivered by a modern 2" touch OLED display Avinox DP100. Two wireless controllers placed directly on the handlebars enable intuitive and convenient control, allowing you to change assist modes or navigate the display while riding without taking your hands off the bars.<br /> <br />Full confidence on the trail is ensured by the fully suspended frame with geometry tailored for serious enduro riding. The FOX AWL HD 36 Air fork with 160 mm travel paired with a FOX Float Rhythm Evol LV shock offers excellent damping on descents and technical sections.<br /> <br />Shifting is taken care of by the SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle (1x12) groupset, paired with an 11–52T cassette and 34T chainring. This delivers smooth power transfer ready for steep climbs and fast sprints alike.<br /> <br />Braking power is crucial – hydraulic four-piston SRAM DB8 Stealth brakes with 200 mm rotors provide control and confidence in all conditions.<br /> <br />The bike rolls on a proven trail tire combo: MAXXIS ASSEGAI (front)...

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 11.11 Avinox M2S | 800 Wh ebike
description_html: ONE-Full 11.11 – Monochrome version of a full-performance, precision-engineered suspension e-bike<br />Minimalism in design, maximum in technology. The ONE-Full 11.11 is designed for riders who demand top performance without unnecessary extravagance.<br /> <br />Inside the durable aluminum frame beats the heart of a Avinox M2S motor (2026) with up to 150 Nm torque (BOOST mode) and up to 1300 W power. Together with intelligent power management (Auto, Trail, Turbo), it provides smooth and strong assistance even in the toughest conditions.<br /> <br />Energy comes from the integrated Avinox 800 Wh battery, which reliably handles technical trails and longer rides. Thanks to compatibility with a 12 A charger, battery charging stops are minimal, using GaN fast-charging technology that recharges the battery from 0 to 75% in approximately 1.5 hours and to 100% in 2 hours and 25 minutes.<br /> <br />Perfect route overview is ensured by the integrated 2" OLED touchscreen Avinox DP100, intuitive, clear and easy to read even on the move thanks to 2 wireless handlebar controllers for easier power assist selection and screen scrolling.<br /> <br />Comfort and handling are provided by FOX suspension: robust FOX AWL HD 36 Air fork with 160 mm travel in front, and FOX Float Rhythm Evol LV shock absorber at the rear, both ready to absorb shocks in demanding terrain.<br /> <br />Shifting is handled by SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle (1x12) with a cassette range of 11–52 teeth and reliable power transfer thanks to SRAM cranks with a 34-tooth chainring.<br /> <br />Braking power is provided by powerful hydraulic SRAM DB8 Stealth 4-piston brakes with 200 mm rotors for maximum safety.<br /> <br />Grip comes from top-tier trail tires MAXXIS ASSEGAI (front) and MINION DHR II (rear) – a combination proven in enduro races and wild descents.<br /> <br />Comfortable riding position ensured by X-Fusion Manic dropper post (various travel lengths depending on frame), 780 mm...

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 12.11 Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
Next-generation carbon e-bike in ultimate form - e-Full 12.11

e-Full 12.11 mountain e-bike pushes boundaries to a new level. Its carbon frame not only reduces weight but also ensures exceptional stiffness and efficient power transfer. Combined with top-level components, it is designed for riders demanding extreme performance on trails, technical terrain, or climbs.

At the heart of its power is the Avinox M2S 2026 motor with torque up to 150 Nm (BOOST mode) and maximum output of 1300 W. This delivers outstanding dynamics, sensitive power delivery, and immediate response.

Energy comes from an integrated Avinox 600 Wh (16.7 Ah) battery, providing sufficient range for full-day rides in the terrain.

The integrated 2" OLED touchscreen Avinox DP100 is clear and intuitive – offering everything from assistance to detailed system diagnostics. Its wireless controller mounted directly on the handlebars offers perfect overview and easier mode selection for greater riding comfort.

Suspension is fully prepared for demanding trails with a front FOX Float 36 Grip (160 mm) fork and rear FOX Float X, 2pos, Evol LV (210x55 mm) shock absorber. This combination provides excellent sensitivity and shock absorption in all situations.

Shifting is handled by the top electronic SRAM GX Eagle AXS T-Type (1x12) groupset with a 10–52 tooth cassette. Safe braking is ensured by the new hydraulic SRAM Maven Base brakes with 200 mm rotors front and rear – strong and stable under all conditions.

MAXXIS ASSEGAI (front) and MINION DHR II (rear) tires, both sized 29x2.50", maintain grip even on imperfect terrain.

The e-bike is complemented by wide RaceFace Chester 780 mm handlebars, a X-Fusion Manic dropper post, and a comfortable SELLE ROYAL saddle.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 12.11-PRO Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
Ultimate carbon lightbike equipped with next generation top components – e-Full 12.11-PRO

The full-suspension mountain e-bike model e-Full 12.11-PRO represents the pinnacle of trail e-bikes with a carbon frame designed for demanding riders who require top performance, lightness, and comfort in tough terrain.

A 600 Wh Avinox battery (16.7 Ah) is elegantly integrated into the frame, providing sufficient range for long rides and technical trails.

The drive is powered by a powerful Avinox M2S 2026 motor delivering up to 150 Nm torque (in Boost mode) and a maximum power of 1300 W, ensuring swift and smooth starts and climbs even in the toughest terrain.

Riding modes are clearly displayed on the integrated 2" OLED touchscreen Avinox DP100, which also allows easy control of functions via a wireless handlebar controller for even easier assist level selection and greater riding comfort.

Suspension features top components from FOX – a FOX Float 36 Factory Grip X2 29" fork with 160 mm travel and 44 mm offset, and a rear shock FOX Float X, 2pos-Adj, Evol LV (210x55 mm).

Precise and wireless shifting is ensured by the SRAM X0 Eagle AXS T-Type 12-speed groupset, equipped with a robust 10–52 tooth cassette and lightweight SRAM X0 Eagle Flattop chain.

The wheels come fitted with light and strong carbon rims FSA E-MTB i29 Carbon and tires MAXXIS ASSEGAI and MINION DHR II in size 29x2.50", guaranteeing maximum traction and confidence on the trail.

Reliable and progressive braking is provided by SRAM Maven Silver hydraulic brakes with 200 mm rotors. The RaceFace Turbine AL handlebars and stem ensure optimal control and comfort even on long rides.

For perfect adjustment, the FOX Transfer dropper post and a comfortable Fizik Terra Ridon X5 saddle is available.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 12.11-PRO REM Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-Full 12.11-PRO REM

CRUSSIS e-Full 12.11-PRO REM is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with a carbon frame, designed for demanding riders looking for high performance, low weight and confidence in technical terrain.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system includes an M2S motor with up to 1,500 W power, 130 Nm torque and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery, which combines lower weight with sufficient capacity for sporty rides and technical trails. A 4A charger is included.

The FOX Float 36 Factory Grip X2 fork with 160 mm travel and the FOX Float X rear shock provide comfort and control. The SRAM X0 Eagle AXS T-Type wireless groupset ensures precise shifting, while the SRAM Maven Silver four-piston brakes provide reliable braking performance.

The FSA E-MTB i29 Carbon carbon wheels are fitted with MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" tires at the front and MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.50" tires at the rear, which provide confidence and traction in challenging terrain. The equipment is complemented by a FOX Transfer dropper post, RaceFace components, Fizik Terra Ridon X5 saddle, and a 2" OLED AVINOX touchscreen display with wireless controller.

The result is an extremely capable carbon e-bike that will offer top performance, precise handling, and comfort on every ride.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 12.11-REM Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
Next-generation carbon e-bike in ultimate form - e-Full 12.11 REM

e-Full 12.11 REM mountain e-bike pushes boundaries to a new level. Its carbon frame not only reduces weight but also ensures exceptional stiffness and efficient power transfer. Combined with top-level components, it is designed for riders demanding extreme performance on trails, technical terrain, or climbs.

At the heart of its power is the Avinox M2S 2026 motor with torque up to 150 Nm (BOOST mode) and maximum output of 1500 W. This delivers outstanding dynamics, sensitive power delivery, and immediate response.

Energy comes from an integrated removable Avinox 600 Wh (16.7 Ah) battery, providing sufficient range for full-day rides in the terrain.

The integrated 2" OLED touchscreen Avinox DP100 is clear and intuitive – offering everything from assistance to detailed system diagnostics. Its wireless controller mounted directly on the handlebars offers perfect overview and easier mode selection for greater riding comfort.

Suspension is fully prepared for demanding trails with a front FOX Float 36 Grip (160 mm) fork and rear FOX Float X, 2pos, Evol LV (210x55 mm) shock absorber. This combination provides excellent sensitivity and shock absorption in all situations.

Shifting is handled by the top electronic SRAM GX Eagle AXS T-Type (1x12) groupset with a 10–52 tooth cassette. Safe braking is ensured by the new hydraulic SRAM Maven Base brakes with 200 mm rotors front and rear – strong and stable under all conditions.

MAXXIS ASSEGAI (front) and MINION DHR II (rear) tires, both sized 29x2.50", maintain grip even on imperfect terrain.

The e-bike is complemented by wide RaceFace Chester 780 mm handlebars, a X-Fusion Manic dropper post, and a comfortable SELLE ROYAL saddle.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full 12.12-PRO X2 Avinox M2S | 800 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-Full 12.12-PRO X2

CRUSSIS e-Full 12.12-PRO X2 represents the top of the CRUSSIS full-suspension e-bike range. It combines the most powerful AVINOX drive unit, electronically controlled FOX suspension, SRAM XX Eagle AXS T-Type wireless shifting and premium carbon wheels into a perfectly coordinated whole. The result is an e-bike that offers maximum performance, precision and confidence even in the most demanding mountain terrain.

The heart of the e-bike is the AVINOX M2S motor with an output of up to 1,300 W, a torque of 130 Nm and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. Thanks to its instant response and smooth power delivery, it handles steep climbs, technical sections and long climbs with ease. The energy is supplied by the AVINOX 800 Wh fixed battery, which provides enough capacity for a full-day ride. The included 12A fast charger also significantly shortens the charging time.

The FOX Podium Factory Grip X2 fork and FOX Float X2 Live Valve Neo rear shock ensure maximum control. The electronically controlled suspension continuously adapts to current conditions and ensures the ideal combination of sensitivity, stability, pedaling efficiency and comfort.

Precise and fast shifting is ensured by the SRAM XX Eagle AXS T-Type wireless set. RACEFACE ERA eMTB Carbon 29" carbon wheels contribute to better acceleration, precise tracking and lower rotational weight. Confidence on steep descents is provided by powerful four-piston SRAM Maven Ultimate brakes.

The equipment is complemented by a FOX Transfer telescopic seatpost and a 2" AVINOX OLED touch screen. There is also modern connectivity, including USB-C.

e-Full 12.12-PRO X2 is a carbon e-bike for riders who want to use the potential of the latest technologies without compromise. It offers maximum performance, precise control and an exceptional riding experience on any terrain.

description_html:
ONE-Full AX 10.12-M2

CRUSSIS ONE-Full AX 10.12-M2 (600 Wh) is a full-suspension mountain e-bike with an aluminum frame that offers a balanced combination of power, stability and confidence in technical terrain. It is ready for steep climbs, fast trails and more demanding descents, where the rider will appreciate precise control and well-matched equipment.

The drive is provided by a technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1,100 W, torque of 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in BOOST mode. Thanks to its smooth response and sensitive power delivery, it offers plenty of support on steep climbs and technical sections. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery, which combines lower weight with sufficient capacity for sporty rides and technical trails. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort and control are provided by the ROCKSHOX Psylo Silver RC air fork with 150 mm travel along with the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select+ RT rear shock. The suspension helps absorb bumps, keep the wheels in contact with the surface and maintain stability when riding fast.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing ensures reliable gear changes even under higher loads. Safe deceleration is provided by SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes.

The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" front tire supports confident tracking, while the MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.40" rear tire contributes to traction during braking and exits. The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC NR telescopic seatpost, a SELLE ROYAL saddle and a 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with one wireless controller.

ONE-Full AX 10.12-M2 (600 Wh) is a versatile full-suspension e-bike for riders looking for a reliable drive, comfortable suspension and confidence when riding in more demanding terrain.

description_html:
e-Full AX 10.12-M2

CRUSSIS e-Full AX 10.12-M2 (800 Wh) is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with an aluminum frame, ready for fast trails, steep climbs and technical descents. It offers a balanced combination of power, stability and comfort for sporty riding in more demanding terrain.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses the M2 motor with an output of up to 1,100 W, a torque of 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in BOOST mode. Smooth power delivery and sensitive response help on demanding climbs and in passages where precise control of the bike is important. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery, suitable for long routes and all-day riding. A 12A quick charger is included.

The ROCKSHOX Psylo Silver RC air fork with 150 mm travel and the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select+ RT rear shock absorb unevenness. This combination supports stable wheel control, contact with the surface and confidence when riding in rugged terrain.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing offers reliable gear changes even under heavy loads. The necessary braking power is provided by the SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes, which provide confidence on technical descents and longer descents.

The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" front tire supports precise tracking, while the MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.40" rear tire contributes to traction on climbs and braking. The equipment is completed by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC NR, a saddle SELLE ROYAL and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers.

e-Full AX 10.12-M2 (800 Wh) is a versatile full-suspension e-bike for riders looking for reliable drive, comfortable suspension and sure control for sporty off-road riding.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full AX 10.12-PRO Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-Full AX 10.12-PRO

CRUSSIS e-Full AX 10.12-PRO is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with an aluminum frame, designed for riders looking for high performance, stability and confidence on fast trails and technical terrain. Carefully selected equipment allows it to handle steep climbs, challenging descents and longer trips off-road.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system includes an M2S motor with up to 1,500 W power, 130 Nm torque and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. It offers fast response, smooth power delivery and plenty of power even on steep climbs. The energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery, which combines lower weight with sufficient capacity for sporty rides and technical trails. A 4A charger is included.

The FOX Float 36 Factory Grip X2 fork with 160 mm of travel together with the FOX Float X rear shock provide comfort and control. This combination helps maintain stability when riding fast, absorbs shocks on broken surfaces and brings confidence in technical passages.

Precise shifting is ensured by the SRAM GX Eagle AXS T-Type electronic set, while safe deceleration is provided by SRAM Maven Bronze B1 four-piston brakes. The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" tires at the front and MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.50" at the rear provide high grip and sure tracking on rocks, gravel and mud.

The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC NR telescopic seatpost, RaceFace components, Fizik Terra Ridon X5 saddle and a 2" OLED touch display AVINOX DP100 with one wireless controller.

e-Full AX 10.12-PRO is a powerful full-suspension e-bike for riders who want to combine modern technology, lower battery weight and reliable control when riding in challenging terrain.

description_html:
e-Full AX 10.12-PRO

CRUSSIS e-Full AX 10.12-PRO is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with an aluminum frame, designed for riders looking for high performance, stability and confidence on fast trails and technical terrain. Carefully selected equipment allows it to handle steep climbs, challenging descents and longer trips off-road.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system includes an M2S motor with up to 1,500 W power, 130 Nm torque and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. It offers fast response, smooth power delivery and plenty of power even on steep climbs. The energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery, which combines lower weight with sufficient capacity for sporty rides and technical trails. A 4A charger is included.

The FOX Float 36 Factory Grip X2 fork with 160 mm of travel together with the FOX Float X rear shock provide comfort and control. This combination helps maintain stability when riding fast, absorbs shocks on broken surfaces and brings confidence in technical passages.

Precise shifting is ensured by the SRAM GX Eagle AXS T-Type electronic set, while safe deceleration is provided by SRAM Maven Bronze B1 four-piston brakes. The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" tires at the front and MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.50" at the rear provide high grip and sure tracking on rocks, gravel and mud.

The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC NR telescopic seatpost, RaceFace components, Fizik Terra Ridon X5 saddle and a 2" OLED touch display AVINOX DP100 with one wireless controller.

e-Full AX 10.12-PRO is a powerful full-suspension e-bike for riders who want to combine modern technology, lower battery weight and reliable control when riding in challenging terrain.

e-Full AX 10.12-PRO

CRUSSIS e-Full AX 10.12-PRO is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with an aluminum frame, designed for riders looking for high performance, stability and confidence on fast trails and technical terrain. Carefully selected equipment allows it to handle steep climbs, challenging descents and longer trips off-road.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system includes an M2S motor with up to 1,500 W power, 130 Nm torque and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. It offers fast response, smooth power delivery and plenty of power even on steep climbs. The energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery, which provides sufficient capacity for long rides and demanding routes. The equipment includes a 12A fast charger.

The FOX Float 36 Factory Grip X2 fork with 160 mm of travel together with the FOX Float X rear shock provide comfort and control. This combination helps maintain stability when riding fast, absorbs shocks on broken surfaces and brings confidence in technical passages.

Precise shifting is ensured by the SRAM GX Eagle AXS T-Type electronic set, while safe deceleration is provided by SRAM Maven Bronze B1 four-piston brakes. The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" tires at the front and MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.50" at the rear provide high grip and sure tracking on rocks, gravel and mud.

The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC NR telescopic seatpost, RaceFace components, Fizik Terra Ridon X5 saddle and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touch screen with two wireless controllers.

e-Full AX 10.12-PRO is a powerful full-suspension e-bike for riders who want to combine modern technology, comfort and reliable control when riding in demanding conditions. terrain.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB full suspension Crussis e-Full AX 9.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Full AX 9.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Full AX 9.12-M2 is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with an aluminum frame, designed for sporty riding, technical passages and longer off-road routes. It combines a modern AVINOX drive, sure suspension and reliable components for riders who want balanced performance and good handling.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. Riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with a left wireless controller.

Comfort and stability are provided by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 150 mm travel together with the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock. This combination helps absorb bumps and maintain confident wheel control on descents and on rugged sections.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a wide range of gears for climbs and faster passages. Effective deceleration is provided by the SRAM DB4 four-piston hydraulic brakes with 200 mm discs, which provide the necessary control for sporty off-road riding.

The SCHWALBE Nobby Nic 29 × 2.60" tires ensure good traction, stability and support on a variety of surfaces. The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC telescopic seatpost, SELLE ROYAL saddle, CRUSSIS components and USB-C.

ONE-Full AX 9.12-M2 is a suitable choice for riders looking for a full-suspension e-bike with AVINOX drive, comfortable suspension and reliable equipment for regular off-road riding.

description_html:
e-Full AX CARB 10.12

CRUSSIS e-Full AX CARB 10.12 is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with a carbon frame that combines low weight, agile handling and equipment ready for sporty riding in rugged terrain. It can handle long rides, fast trails and technical passages where precision and control are important.

The drive is provided by the AVINOX system with the M2 motor, which offers power up to 1,100 W, torque of 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in BOOST mode. Its smooth performance and sensitive power distribution help on steep climbs and when passing through difficult sections. Energy is supplied by the AVINOX 600 Wh fixed battery, which combines lower weight with sufficient capacity for sporty rides and technical trails. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort and stability are provided by the ROCKSHOX Psylo Silver RC air fork with 150 mm travel together with the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select+ RT rear shock. This combination effectively absorbs bumps and helps keep the bike under control on rugged surfaces and fast descents.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing ensures reliable gear changes even under heavy loads. The necessary confidence when slowing down is provided by the SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes.

The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" front tire supports precise tracking, while the MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.40" rear tire contributes to traction on climbs and braking. The equipment is completed by a X-FUSION MANIC LC NR telescopic seatpost, a SELLE ROYAL saddle, and a 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with one wireless controller.

e-Full AX CARB 10.12 is a balanced carbon e-bike for riders looking for reliable performance, lightweight construction, and confidence when riding in more challenging terrain.

description_html:
e-Full AX CARB 10.12 REM

CRUSSIS e-Full AX CARB 10.12 REM is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with a carbon frame that combines low weight, agile handling and equipment focused on sporty riding in rugged terrain. The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle gearing offers reliable gear changes even when riding under load. Controlled deceleration is ensured by SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes, which provide plenty of braking power on technical descents and longer descents.

The MAXXIS ASSEGAI 29 × 2.50" tire at the front supports confident tracking, while the MAXXIS MINION DHR II 29 × 2.40" at the rear contributes to traction during braking and exits. The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC NR dropper post, a SELLE ROYAL saddle, and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers.

e-Full AX CARB 10.12 REM offers a balanced combination of carbon construction, powerful drivetrain, and durable trail equipment for riders who want to explore more challenging terrain without unnecessary restrictions.

e-Full AX CARB 10.12-PRO REM

CRUSSIS e-Full AX CARB 10.12-PRO REM combines a lightweight carbon frame, a powerful AVINOX system and equipment ready for fast trails, technical sections and long rides. It is designed for riders looking for low weight, precise control and confidence in demanding terrain.

description_html:
e-Full AX CARB 9.12

CRUSSIS e-Full AX CARB 9.12-M2 is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with a carbon frame that combines low weight, strength and sure handling in the terrain. It is designed for sporty riding, technical passages and longer routes, where the rider will appreciate more precise wheel guidance and balanced mounting.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a AVINOX 600 Wh fixed battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. Riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with a left wireless controller.

Control and comfort are provided by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 150 mm of travel together with the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock. The suspension helps maintain traction and stability on descents, on technical sections and when riding faster in rugged terrain.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a wide range of gears for steeper climbs and brisk passages. Safe deceleration is provided by the SRAM DB4 four-piston hydraulic brakes with 200 mm discs, which provide the necessary control during sporty riding. deployment.

The SCHWALBE Nobby Nic 29 × 2.60" tires provide sure grip and good support on a variety of surfaces. The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC telescopic seatpost, SELLE ROYAL saddle, CRUSSIS components and USB-C.

e-Full AX CARB 9.12-M2 is a suitable choice for riders looking for a lighter and more sporty full-suspension e-bike with a carbon frame, AVINOX drive and reliable equipment for regular off-road riding.

e-Full AX CARB 9.12

CRUSSIS e-Full AX CARB 9.12-M2S is a full-suspension mountain electric bike with a carbon frame that combines low weight, strength and sporty character with the significant support of the AVINOX drive. The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with the M2S engine, which offers power up to 1300 W, torque 130 Nm and up to 150 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. The SCHWALBE Nobby Nic 29 × 2.60" tires ensure sure grip, stability and good support on a variety of surfaces. The equipment is complemented by a X-FUSION MANIC LC telescopic seatpost, SELLE ROYAL saddle, CRUSSIS components and USB-C.

e-Full AX CARB 9.12-M2S is a suitable choice for riders looking for a sports-oriented full-suspension e-bike with a carbon frame, a more powerful AVINOX drive and reliable equipment for more demanding off-road riding.

e-Full AX CARB 9.12 REM-M2S is a suitable choice for riders looking for a sports-oriented full-suspension e-bike with a carbon frame, removable battery, more powerful AVINOX drive and reliable equipment for more demanding off-road riding.

description_html:
e-Full AX SUV 10.12

CRUSSIS e-Full AX SUV 10.12 combines the capabilities of a full-suspension mountain electric bike with the practicality of a model for everyday travel. The Aluminum frame and comfortable geometry give the bike confidence on forest roads, broken surfaces and on longer trips, while a wide range of accessories extends its use to city transportation.

The technologically advanced AVINOX system uses an M2S motor with an output of up to 1,500 W, a torque of 130 Nm and up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. The power starts smoothly and provides sufficient support on steep climbs, riding with a load and on long routes. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery, which offers capacity for all-day trips. A 12A quick charger is included.

Riding comfort is ensured by the ROCKSHOX Psylo Silver RC air fork with 150 mm travel and the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select+ RT rear shock. The full-suspension design helps smooth out bumps, maintain stability, and save the rider's energy on unpaved roads even during longer journeys.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle group takes care of shifting, allowing you to reliably select gears even under load. SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes ensure safe speed control. SCHWALBE Johnny Watts 29 × 2.35" tires offer balanced grip, comfort and low rolling resistance on asphalt and lighter terrain.

The equipment is complemented by a telescopic X-FUSION MANIC LC NR seatpost, an adjustable stem and a 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers. There is also a powerful AVINOX front light, a rear light and a wide range of accessories for everyday use.

e-Full AX SUV 10.12 is a versatile full-suspension e-bike for riders who want to handle commuting, weekend trips and off-road adventures on one bike.

description_html:
e-Full AX SUV 9.12

CRUSSIS e-Full AX SUV 9.12-M2 is a full-suspension SUV electric bike with an aluminum frame that combines the comfort of a suspension mountain bike with the practicality for everyday use and longer trips. It is suitable for asphalt, cycle paths and paved roads, where you will appreciate stability, comfort and universal equipment.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. The riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with a left wireless controller.

The ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 150 mm travel and the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock ensure comfort and confidence while riding. The suspension helps to effectively smooth out bumps and maintain stable wheel control even on rougher roads.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing provides a sufficient range of gears for climbing and a faster pace. Safe deceleration is ensured by the SRAM DB4 four-piston hydraulic brakes with 200 mm discs, which provide the necessary control even at higher speeds. load.

The SCHWALBE Hybrid Johnny Watts 29 × 2.35" tires are suitable for combined use on and off-road and support sure-footed handling and comfortable rolling. The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC, AVINOX 1200 lm front light, SUPERNOVA TL3 Z rear light, mudguards, a MIK rack, a kickstand, a chain guard and USB-C.

e-Full AX SUV 9.12-M2 is a suitable choice for riders looking for a comfortable full-suspension SUV electric bike with AVINOX drive, practical equipment and universal use for everyday riding and longer trips.

CRUSSIS e-Full AX SUV 9.12-M2 is a full-suspension SUV electric bike with an aluminum frame that combines the comfort of a suspension mountain bike with the practicality for everyday use and longer trips. It is suitable for asphalt, cycle paths and paved roads, where you will appreciate stability, comfort and universal equipment.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. The riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with a left wireless controller.

The ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 150 mm travel and the ROCKSHOX Deluxe Select R rear shock ensure comfort and confidence while riding. The suspension helps to effectively smooth out bumps and maintain stable wheel control even on rougher roads.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing provides a sufficient range of gears for climbing and a faster pace. Safe deceleration is ensured by the SRAM DB4 four-piston hydraulic brakes with 200 mm discs, which provide the necessary control even at higher speeds. load.

The SCHWALBE Hybrid Johnny Watts 29 × 2.35" tires are suitable for combined use on and off-road and support sure-footed handling and comfortable rolling. The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC, AVINOX 1200 lm front light, SUPERNOVA TL3 Z rear light, mudguards, a MIK rack, a kickstand, a chain guard and USB-C.

e-Full AX SUV 9.12-M2 is a suitable choice for riders looking for a comfortable full-suspension SUV electric bike with AVINOX drive, practical equipment and universal use for everyday riding and longer trips.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB hardtail Crussis e-Hard 11.11 Avinox M2S | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
E-bike e-Hard 11.11: Experience uncompromising performance with the next-generation mountain e-bike!

The foundation of this e-bike is a lightweight aluminum frame, offering the necessary strength and comfort even on long trails. The bike is powered by a high-performance Avinox M2S (2026) motor with a peak power of up to 1300 W and a torque of 130 Nm, or up to 150 Nm in BOOST mode. This ensures powerful acceleration and smooth traction even on steep climbs.

The Avinox 600 Wh battery is elegantly integrated into the frame, maintaining a sporty look and low center of gravity. It provides enough energy for longer rides and more demanding terrains.

A 2" touch OLED display Avinox DP100 with a wireless handlebar controller gives you full ride control. Effortless assistance selection and intuitive operation enhance comfort and visibility during your ride.

Comfort on trails is ensured by the FOX AWL 34 suspension fork (130 mm travel), which smooths out bumps and delivers responsive handling on technical terrain. The X-Fusion Manic dropper post allows quick saddle adjustment on the go.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1x12 drivetrain offers smooth and precise shifting, while SRAM DB8 Stealth hydraulic brakes with 200 mm discs front and rear provide powerful and consistent braking in all conditions.

MAXXIS REKON 29x2.60 tires offer excellent grip and traction on roots, gravel, and muddy terrain.

The CRUSSIS e-Hard 11.11 blends sporty DNA with cutting-edge technology — ideal for demanding athletes, experienced hobby riders, and trail enthusiasts looking for a reliable machine for any terrain.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică MTB hardtail Crussis e-Largo AX 10.12 Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
ONE-Largo AX 10.12

CRUSSIS ONE-Largo AX 10.12-M2 is a mountain electric bike with an aluminum rigid frame that is ready for sporty riding, longer trips and more demanding off-road routes. It combines a powerful AVINOX drive, reliable handling and comfortable equipment, so it will serve well both on regular rides and on all-day trips.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort and confidence in the terrain are ensured by the ROCKSHOX Psylo Silver RC air fork with 130 mm travel, which helps absorb bumps and keep the e-bike under control even on rougher trails. MAXXIS Rekon 29 × 2.60" tires provide good traction and stability on forest roads, gravel and more demanding terrain.

The SRAM 70 T-Type Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a wide range of gears for steeper climbs and more agile riding. Safe deceleration is ensured by SRAM DB6 four-piston hydraulic brakes, which provide the necessary confidence on descents even in variable conditions.

The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC NR, thanks to which you can easily adjust the position according to the current situation and gain more freedom when riding off-road.

ONE-Largo AX 10.12-M2 is suitable for riders looking for a powerful mountain e-bike with a solid frame and enough power and comfort for everyday rides, weekend trips and more sporty off-road riding.

The equipment is complemented by a telescopic seatpost X-FUSION MANIC LC NR, thanks to which you can easily adjust the position according to the current situation and gain more freedom when riding off-road.

e-Largo AX 10.12-M2 is suitable for riders looking for a powerful mountain e-bike with a solid frame and enough power and comfort for everyday rides, weekend trips and more sporty off-road riding.

The equipment is complemented by CRUSSIS and USB-C components, which underline the practical focus of the e-bike for regular use.

e-SUV AX 8.12

CRUSSIS e-SUV AX 8.12-M2 is a versatile SUV electric bike with an aluminum rigid frame that offers comfortable handling and practical use for everyday commuting, trips and off-road riding. Thanks to its universal equipment, it can handle city traffic, cycle paths and unpaved roads.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. The equipment includes a 4A charger.

The SR-SUNTOUR XCM32 LO DS suspension fork with 120 mm travel ensures comfort on both paved and unpaved roads. SCHWALBE Advancer Hybrid PunctureGuard 29 × 2.35" tires support a stable and comfortable ride on asphalt, gravel and other surfaces.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a sufficient range of gears for both normal climbs and more agile riding. SHIMANO BR-MT200 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs ensure safe deceleration.

The practical side of the e-bike is complemented by mudguards, a rack with MIK system, a kickstand and a chain cover. For riding in reduced visibility, there is a LITEMOVE SE-70 front light and SUPERNOVA TL3 rear light. Z.

CRUSSIS e-SUV AX 8.12-M2 is a versatile SUV electric bike with an aluminum rigid frame that offers comfortable handling and practical use for everyday commuting, trips and off-road riding. Thanks to its universal equipment, it can handle city traffic, cycle paths and unpaved roads.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. The equipment includes a 4A charger.

The SR-SUNTOUR XCM32 LO DS suspension fork with 120 mm travel ensures comfort on both paved and unpaved roads. SCHWALBE Advancer Hybrid PunctureGuard 29 × 2.35" tires support a stable and comfortable ride on asphalt, gravel and other surfaces.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a sufficient range of gears for both normal climbs and more agile riding. SHIMANO BR-MT200 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs ensure safe deceleration.

The practical side of the e-bike is complemented by mudguards, a rack with MIK system, a kickstand and a chain cover. For riding in reduced visibility, there is a LITEMOVE SE-70 front light and SUPERNOVA TL3 rear light. Z.

e-SUV AX 8.12-M2 is suitable for riders looking for a versatile SUV e-bike with comfortable equipment, a powerful AVINOX drive and a practical focus for everyday travel and leisure trips.

description_html:
e-SUV AX 9.12

CRUSSIS e-SUV AX 9.12-M2 is a versatile SUV e-bike with an aluminum rigid frame that combines the comfort of a trekking e-bike with the confidence of a mountain model. It is suitable for everyday commuting, longer trips and off-road riding, where you will appreciate stable handling, comfort and a strong AVINOX drive.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which provides power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Energy is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included.

Comfort when riding on paved and unpaved roads is supported by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel. The SCHWALBE Advancer Hybrid PunctureGuard 29 × 2.35" tires are suitable for a combination of asphalt, gravel and unpaved roads and contribute to the confident and comfortable performance of the e-bike.

The SRAM S100 Eagle 1×12 gearing offers a sufficient range of gears for climbing and more agile riding. Safe deceleration is ensured by the SRAM DB4 four-piston hydraulic brakes, which provide the necessary control on and off the road.

For everyday use, there is an AVINOX 1200 lm front light and a wide range of practical accessories, thanks to which the e-bike is ready for commuting, trips and longer journeys.

e-SUV AX 9.12-M2 is suitable for riders looking for a versatile e-bike with a powerful AVINOX drive, comfortable equipment and the ability to handle city traffic, cycle paths and routes off-paved roads.

e-SUV BELT AX 10.12

CRUSSIS e-SUV BELT AX 10.12-M2 (600 Wh) is a versatile SUV electric bike with an aluminum frame, designed for comfortable commuting, everyday riding and longer trips. It combines a quiet belt drive, smooth manual shifting and practical equipment for the city, cycle paths and paved roads.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 motor, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. CRUSSIS e-SUV BELT AX 10.12-M2-AUTO (600 Wh) is a versatile SUV electric bike with an aluminum frame that combines comfort for everyday riding with equipment suitable for longer trips. Thanks to the automatic gearshift, belt drive and practical mounting, it is suitable for the city, cycle paths and paved roads outside it.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. The riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with a left wireless controller.

Instead of a classic chain, the bike uses a Gates Carbon Drive CDX belt, which offers quiet operation and low maintenance. In combination with the Enviolo Utility hub and the Enviolo CliQ Pro system, it ensures automatic smooth shifting, so the gears adapt to the riding situation without the need for classic shifting.

Comfort on rough roads is increased by the ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel. SCHWALBE Motion Big Apple RaceGuard 28 × 2.35" tires. stability and confidence on asphalt and paved roads. Safe deceleration is ensured by SHIMANO Deore BR-MT410 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs.

The practical equipment is complemented by the AVINOX 1200 lm front light, SUPERNOVA TL3 Z PRO rear light, mudguards, a MIK rack, a kickstand, a belt cover and USB-C. The adjustable stem also allows you to easily adjust the seat to your preferences.

e-SUV BELT AX 10.12-M2-AUTO (600 Wh) offers comfortable handling, automatic shifting and a quiet belt drive in a design suitable for both daily commuting and recreational travel.

model_name: Bicicletă electrică trekking Crussis e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12-AUTO Avinox M2 | 600 Wh ebike
description_html:
e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12 AUTO

CRUSSIS e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12-M2-AUTO (600 Wh) is a comfortable SUV electric bike with an aluminum frame and low step-in, which makes it easy to get on and off. Thanks to the automatic gearshift, quiet belt drive and practical equipment, it is suitable for everyday commuting, longer trips and comfortable travel around the city and paved roads.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 600 Wh battery with a range of up to 117 km. A 4A charger is included. The riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DPC100 touchscreen display with a left wireless controller.

The Gates Carbon Drive CDX belt provides quiet operation and low maintenance. In conjunction with the Enviolo Utility hub and the Enviolo CliQ Pro system, it offers automatic smooth shifting, so the transmission adapts to the riding situation without the need for classic shifting.

The ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel increases riding comfort. The SCHWALBE Motion Big Apple RaceGuard 28 × 2.35" tires support comfortable rolling and stability on asphalt and paved roads. Safe deceleration is ensured by SHIMANO Deore BR-MT410 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs.

The practical equipment is complemented by the AVINOX 1200 lm front light, SUPERNOVA TL3 Z PRO rear light, mudguards, a MIK rack, a kickstand, a belt cover and USB-C. The adjustable stem and low step-in contribute to a comfortable and easily adaptable seat.

e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12-M2-AUTO (600 Wh) is suitable for riders who want a comfortable SUV electric bike with a low step-in, automatic gear shifting, quiet belt drive and equipment for everyday use and longer trips.

description_html:
e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12 AUTO

CRUSSIS e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12-M2-AUTO (800 Wh) is a comfortable SUV electric bike with an aluminum frame and low step-in, which makes it easy to get on and off. Thanks to the automatic gearshift, quiet belt drive and practical equipment, it is suitable for everyday commuting, longer trips and comfortable travel around the city and paved roads.

The drive is provided by the most technologically advanced AVINOX system with an M2 engine, which offers power up to 1100 W, torque 110 Nm and up to 125 Nm in Boost mode for a short time. Power is supplied by a removable AVINOX 800 Wh battery with a range of up to 157 km. A 12A charger is included. The riding data is displayed on the 2" OLED AVINOX DP100 touchscreen display with two wireless controllers.

The Gates Carbon Drive CDX belt provides quiet operation and low maintenance. In conjunction with the Enviolo Utility hub and the Enviolo CliQ Pro system, it offers automatic smooth shifting, so the transmission adapts to the riding situation without the need for classic shifting.

The ROCKSHOX Recon Silver RL air fork with 120 mm travel increases riding comfort. The SCHWALBE Motion Big Apple RaceGuard 28 × 2.35" tires support comfortable rolling and stability on asphalt and paved roads. Safe deceleration is ensured by SHIMANO Deore BR-MT410 hydraulic two-piston brakes with 180mm discs.

The practical equipment is complemented by the AVINOX 1200 lm front light, SUPERNOVA TL3 Z PRO rear light, mudguards, a MIK rack, a kickstand, a belt cover and USB-C. The adjustable stem and low step-in contribute to a comfortable and easily adaptable seat.

e-SUV low BELT AX 10.12-M2-AUTO (800 Wh) is suitable for riders who want a comfortable SUV electric bike with a low step-in, automatic gear shifting, quiet belt drive and equipment for everyday use and longer trips.
